title: Idempotent request handler
prompt:
Implement the idempotency layer in idem.py.

run_once(store, key, fn) executes fn() for a new key and returns its result. For
a key seen before it returns the stored result and does not call fn again.

If fn raises, the exception propagates and nothing is stored, so a retry with
the same key runs fn again.

Concurrent callers with the same key must run fn exactly once: the second caller
waits for the first and then receives the same result (or the same exception
re-raised). fn must never run twice for one key, even under threads.

Store is any mutable mapping the caller passes in. Results may be any object.

Only idem.py should change.
